dataset: CUMAP wins and Wilcoxon p are computed on ALL entries (RAW + PP combined, n=58); both are therefore identical across the RAW and PP sheets. Mean is per-sheet, since RAW and PP scores are not on the same scale. Per-method n varies because some baselines failed (OOM / NaN) on some datasets.

Note: For datasets beyond ~10^5 cells, dense pairwise distances are infeasible (500K cells -> 1TB; 1.1M cells -> 5TB), so an approximate-kNN (lean) implementation on GPU is used. This is a scalability requirement of the method, and all rows use the same fixed weights.

Cortex_F (K=81) and Cortex_P (K=93) score the same cells against the fine-grained DropViz sub-clusters instead of the 14 global classes. scICE cannot reach that many clusters (its stability filter tops out at 7/14/6/17), so its entry there is the best of all its candidate cluster counts, an upper bound in its favour. These two rows share cells with the coarse Cortex rows, so the pairs are not independent.
